accepted_results: Lattice-hull reduction, including all lower-dimensional hulls.
Width-dependent slicing bound for every primitive integer normal, with the sharper surface coefficient valid also for degenerate bodies.
Uniform target-form bound for every fixed bounded-lattice-width class.
Uniform target-form bound for hollow bodies by classical flatness.
A divergent normalized target-residual sequence must have lattice width tending to infinity.
Height-one-pyramid obstruction to auxiliary coefficientwise Ehrhart bounds.
scope_warnings: The width-dependent constant is not the unrestricted dimension-only target constant.
Large lattice width does not imply Euclidean inradius tending to infinity; the exact unimodular-shear example is retained.
The pyramid obstruction is not a counterexample to weakened Wills.
The nonnegative Euclidean-minus-lattice surface deficit Delta(P) is essential.
remaining_gap: A shape-uniform bound in each fixed dimension for the lower Ehrhart coefficient sum after subtracting Delta(P), over full-dimensional lattice polytopes of unbounded lattice width.
